blocks.name: Attribution and label contract
blocks.description: Original MIT payloads and projects, generated by build_example.py using native OpenCV QRCodeEncoder. No customer or third-party images. Integer module scaling and an explicit four-module quiet zone preserve binary edges. Ordinary and UTF-8 ECI labels read back through the native reader. Structured append generates three ordered native images in a FlowGroup plus a contact sheet; the sheet is a preview, not a complete decoded inspection result. Ordered recovery of missing/duplicated fragments remains S1-162. The capacity project intentionally fails without output. Result-graphics bounds are separate from the pristine output label. No print-quality grade or scanner/lighting robustness qualification is claimed.
